question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Inclusion
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Omission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inclusion"** means the action or state of including or being included within a group or structure. (शामिल करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The inclusion of new students in the class was seamless and smooth.
 
 
 
• **"Omission" **refers to something that has been left out or excluded. (छोड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The omission of his name from the list was an oversight.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Inclusion' **is **'Omission'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Omission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boost** (बढ़ावा देना): An increase or improvement.

 
 
• **Example:** The new marketing strategy helped boost sales.
 
 
 
• **Accrual** (वृद्धि): The process of accumulating or receiving payments or benefits over time.
 
 
• **Example:** The accrual of interest on the savings account was substantial.
 
 
 
• **Gain** (लाभ): Obtain or secure something desired.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked hard to gain the trust of his peers.
